expr: fetch('/api/storage').then(r => r.json()).then(d => { if (!d.print_ready.files || !d.orders.photos) throw Error('nothing to clean: ' + JSON.stringify([d.print_ready.files, d.orders.photos])); return JSON.stringify({finished: d.print_ready.files, orderPhotos: d.orders.photos, canvas: d.workspace.canvas.files, incoming: d.incoming.files}); })

fetch('/api/storage').then(r => r.json()).then(d => { const left = {finished: d.print_ready.files, orders: d.orders.items.length, orderPhotos: d.orders.photos, canvas: d.workspace.canvas.files, passport: d.workspace.passport.files, incoming: d.incoming.files}; if (left.finished || left.orderPhotos || left.canvas || left.passport || left.incoming || left.orders !== 1 || prints.items.length || canvasPrints.items.length || pp.jobs.length) throw Error('left: ' + JSON.stringify(left)); return document.querySelector('#storage-status').textContent; })
